# Figure Captions

1. DH-ADOM hierarchy: Engineering Constitution → AI-SDLC → ADLC → Root → Feature → Specialist.
2. Lifecycle integration: software lifecycle and agent lifecycle converge in governed implementation and evidence.
3. Delegation sequence: request routing, bounded specialist execution, handoff, and Root review.
4. Agent state machine: controlled promotion, suspension, revalidation, and retirement.
5. Ownership boundaries: Feature Agents own bounded domains; cross-feature changes require Root coordination.
6. Security and delegation controls: contract, policy, authorization, budget, and side-effect firewall.
7. Traceability chain: intent-to-production lineage.
8. Reference architecture: Root orchestration over feature domains and shared governance infrastructure.
